{{Top}}
[[File:Meditation_Garden.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The [[Jedi Temple meditation gardens|Jedi Temple Meditation Garden]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]]]
{{Quote|Come, walk with me through the balcony garden, and I shall take your mind off your worries [&hellip;]|[[Wendell Wright-Sims]], to [[Mayli Weng]]|<ref name="An Old Flame in Need...">{{WEGCite|story=An Old Flame in Need...|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>}}
A '''garden''' was an area in which [[Plant/Legends|plants]] were cultivated for recreational or aesthetic, rather than purely [[Farm/Legends|agricultural]], reasons. They could range from large public gardens, tended by professional gardeners, to small private plots for the raising of flowers or fresh crops. Gardens could by cultivated outdoors or indoors in [[greenhouse]]s or open spaces. Some gardens deliberately included wildlife, and most attracted [[Insect/Legends|insects]]. Some gardens, like the [[Garden of Butterflies]] on [[New Escrow]], were designed explicitly to support and attract wildlife.<ref name="Star Wars 48: The Third Law">[[Star Wars (1977) 48|''Star Wars'' (1977) 48]]</ref>

The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] found gardens aesthetically appealing and peaceful, and the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] included [[Jedi Temple meditation gardens|Meditation Gardens]] on many floors.<ref name="Heart of Fire">{{StoryCite|story=Heart of Fire (comic story)|book=Dark Horse Extra|bformatted=''Dark Horse Extra'' 35&ndash;37}}</ref>

Gardening&mdash;the practice of maintaining a garden&mdash;was also popular among higher-ranking segments of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was known to maintain lavish private gardens, employing master gardeners to cultivate them and stealing gardeners from any subordinate whose gardeners rivaled his. Prince [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], who was not part of the government but played Imperial politics at the highest levels, likewise had opulent gardens on his personal [[Skyhook/Legends|skyhook]].<ref name="Shadows of the Empire">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref> Another prominent Imperial who gardened was [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Imperial Fleet]], who ruled the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. He kept a [[Pellaeon Gardens|garden]] to which he tended personally, finding the idea of imposing orderliness and organization on nature and giving each plant equal allotments and opportunity to grow to be a positive metaphor for the Remnant's practices.<ref name="Destiny's Way">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref> [[General/Legends|General]] [[Evir Derricote]], a botanist at heart, also kept a garden which he tended personally, sometimes putting more attention into it than to running the [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Group]]. His subordinate, [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]], also tended to the same garden and seemed to enjoy doing so, perhaps because of his roots growing up on an [[agro-combine]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="In the Empire's Service">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: In the Empire's Service]]''</ref>
